_comment: Sakura collection. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed sakura-hanami` (lines may be shared with other collections since #24), then given a look each (three lines per look). Shared look in styles/_sakura.py.

readme.title: Sakura
looks: each line wears one look: blush pink with white-pink blossoms (Flabebe, Swirlix, Marill); hanami, pale cream with dark cherry branches in bloom (Oddish, Shuckle, Stonjourner); yozakura, night sakura on deep navy with glowing blossoms and paper lanterns (Gimmighoul, Kecleon, Tynamo); a pink sakura kimono with a red obi (Rookidee, Cramorant, Bouffalant); a petal storm drifting across blush pink (Caterpie, Wurmple, Trapinch); spring green dotted with blossom (Nacli, Bergmite, Magnemite)
the night blossoms and lanterns glow and the petals drift in the dark; the eyes keep their own colours
